<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion appears at m/z 233.9632. Assuming this corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is approximately 232.956 Da. A formula that matches this mass and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (notably a noticeable M+2 peak) is C13H10O2Cl. This fits the required format.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O2Cl</final_answer>
